subject.title: [Feature]: Detect Containerized Environments and Disable Update Suggestions

question: Should detected containers automatically suppress update.auto.enabled and manual update.run actions, or should only advisory update suggestions be replaced with redeploy guidance?
rationale: The PR crosses from guidance into changing an explicit stored auto-update setting and manual operator actions, so automation cannot choose the product policy safely.

options.title: Complete Container Update Policy
options.body: Gate or replace update availability, the Config page Update button, and update.run behavior in detected containers, then document and test the chosen auto-update behavior before merge.

options.title: Suppress Only Suggestions
options.body: Keep explicit update.auto.enabled and manual update.run behavior intact while replacing non-actionable banners and status hints with redeploy-image guidance.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR open but paused until maintainers settle the broader policy on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94279.

recommendation.title: Complete Container Update Policy
recommendation.body: Gate or replace update availability, the Config page Update button, and update.run behavior in detected containers, then document and test the chosen auto-update behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the relevant update-check/status behavior and appears most connected to the current update policy surface.
